labels.rationale: Usage question: how to get a rendered Table as a string. Rich documents Console(record=True) with export_text() for this.

body:
A `Table` can be turned into plain text with a recording console. Create the console with `record=True`, print the table to it, then call `export_text()`:

```python
from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table

console = Console(record=True)
console.print(table)
text = console.export_text()
```

The [exporting section](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst) of the console docs covers this. `save_text()` writes the same output straight to a file. For further usage questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
